name: Multi-view Optimal Transport for Multi-view Crowd Localization and Tracking

raw_payload.title: Multi-view Optimal Transport for Multi-view Crowd Localization and Tracking
raw_payload.summary: Multi-view crowd localization and tracking aim to predict the ground-plane positions of all individuals in the scene and estimate their trajectories over time. Existing multi-view localization methods typically rely on Gaussian-smoothed density map supervision, whose inherent ambiguity in crowded regions may blur local peaks and degrade localization accuracy. In this work, we introduce a multi-view optimal transport framework that directly supervises point-level predictions on the ground plane, thereby avoiding the limitations of density map regression. Specifically, we propose a Mahalanobis distance-based multi-view optimal transport loss (M-MVOT), whose transport cost incorporates view ray direction and object-to-camera distance within a Mahalanobis formulation, with the direction guiding the ellipse orientation and the distance modulating the cost magnitude. For multi-view tracking, we first extend the proposed localization framework in a tracking-by-detection manner (MVOT-TBD). To further improve performance, we introduce a tracking-specific optimal transport loss (MVOT-Track) that explicitly supervises inter-frame association. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed optimal transport-based framework consistently outperforms density map-based localization and tracking on multiple multi-view crowd datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/zqyq/MVOT-Track.
